# Hao Li

> Hao Li is a Postdoctoral Researcher at Queen's University (SAIL Lab and MCIS Lab)
> in Kingston, Ontario, Canada. He researches Agentic Software Engineering (AgenticSE),
> Software Engineering for AI (SE4AI), and software package ecosystems, and leads the
> creation of the AIDev dataset. He received his Ph.D. from the University of Alberta
> in 2024. ORCID: 0000-0003-4468-5972.

## Identity
- Full name: Hao Li
- Role: Postdoctoral Researcher
- Affiliation: Queen's University, Kingston, Ontario, Canada
- Labs: SAIL (https://sail.cs.queensu.ca/), MCIS (https://mcis.cs.queensu.ca/)
- Ph.D.: University of Alberta, 2024 (Advisor: Cor-Paul Bezemer)
- Postdoc advisors: Ahmed E. Hassan, Bram Adams

## Research areas
- Agentic Software Engineering (AgenticSE): https://agenticse-book.github.io/
- Software Engineering for Artificial Intelligence (SE4AI)
- Software Package Ecosystems
